prerequisites: Prior knowledge of Graphic Expression course is recommended.
Students should have notions of sketching, fluent handling of drawing software, and bibliographic research skills.

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and represent engineering structures and installation drawings.
Correctly use specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards for the graphical representation of industrial installations.
Customize CAD applications for specific installations and drawings.
Organize and manage CAD systems in companies.
Exchange drawing files between applications and over the Internet.

syllabus_topics: CAD / BIM / MEP / Visualization / Animation / Simulation software.
BIM systems. Parametric modeling of structures and architecture.
Scientific visualization. Animation and Simulation of 3D models.
Exchange of drawing files between different software applications.
Principles of dimensioning applied to industrial installations. Standards.

assessment_methods.method: Active participation and correct completion of proposed exercises

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.75 * EV2 + 0.25 * EV4. Students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (Classroom and Laboratory practices) to be considered for continuous evaluation. If minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. For the Extraordinary Evaluation, students who fail must submit a new or corrected personal project. Differentiated evaluation involves participation via the virtual campus and submission of a personal project.
